question:
The following pie-chart shows the distribution of the monthly income of a man. The monthly income of the man is ₹84,000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7be60392dc7b2d27026341e510763d4d7eb94d7d550d1693659af04d2d46e86.png] 

How much does he spend on children's fees in a year?
solution:
Given: 

The following pie-chart shows the distribution of the monthly income of a man. The monthly income of the man is ₹84,000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7be60392dc7b2d27026341e510763d4d7eb94d7d550d1693659af04d2d46e86.png] 

Calculation:- 

We know that

Childrens fees = 10% of income 

Fees = 10% of 84000

Fees = 0.10 × 84000 = Rs. 8400 per month

For 1 year expense on fees = 8400 × 12 = Rs. 100800

**∴ He spend Rs. 100800 on children's fees in a year.**

91
